## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Geospatial interfaces
//
// The shared interface of regions on a planet's surface: the containment test
// every geospatial region shape answers.

// A region on the planet's surface that can test whether it contains a
// geodetic coordinate (altitude is ignored).
interface IGeoRegion
    inherits IValue
{
    ContainsCoordinate(x: Self, coordinate: GeoCoordinate): Boolean;
}
```
